Blocks.Text: Warning

Deprecation Notice:
The Marketing Version 202601 (Marketing January 2026) will be sunset on January 15, 2027. We recommend that you migrate to the latest versioned APIs to avoid disruptions. For information on all the supported versions, refer to the migrations documentation.
If you haven’t yet migrated and have questions, submit a request on the LinkedIn Developer Support Portal.

Starting with version 202611, you can build custom Boost targeting and save audiences for reuse. The shared /rest/boostTargetingCriteria resource manages account-owned audiences for both Member Boost and Company Page Boost.
Use a member OAuth access token and include Linkedin-Version: 202611 and X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0 on every request.
Your application must have the relevant Boost permission and the authenticated member must be authorized for the account.
Version 202611 replaces the October include.and.or and exclude.or representation with includeAll and excludeAny.

Rows.Text: The inclusion entries. A member must match every entry (AND). Creation and targeting edits require a location facet with at least one value.
The exclusion entries. A member matching any entry is excluded (OR).
The targeting facet URN. Group all selected values for one facet into one entry.
The selected values for the facet. A member matches an entry if they match any value (OR).
The optional display names returned with criteria. Requests only need the URNs.
The saved-audience ID, absent for an unsaved audience.
The audience name and optional description.
The owning sponsored account. Set it at creation; it can't be changed.
The audience category: SUGGESTED_AUDIENCE for a LinkedIn-generated audience or USER_AUDIENCE for an advertiser-built audience. Read-only on the saved-audience resource.
The read-only ownership, estimated size, and timestamps. Timestamps use epoch milliseconds. Account-owned audiences have ownership: ACCOUNT.

Blocks.Text: Interface locale targeting is optional. If it is omitted, Boost adds a default language when resolving the criteria. It isn't a required client-supplied facet.
For example, the following audience includes members in the United States whose interface language is English:
Suggested audiences and saved audiences can contain facets that Boost doesn't offer for custom audience creation. Preserve these facets when passing the audience to Hydrate and Post.

For a SUGGESTED_AUDIENCE, advertisers can edit only locations and interface locales. Keep all other facets unchanged. Suggested audiences don't have a saved-audience ID and can't be saved directly through boostTargetingCriteria.

For an advertiser-built audience retrieved from Campaign Manager, allow edits only to locations and the facets available through Init's targetingEntities; display other facets as read-only and preserve their values. Creating a saved audience through boostTargetingCriteria accepts only supported Boost facets.

When applying a selected audience to an existing campaign, follow the Boost Manage targeting requirements, including type and the saved-audience id when required. Updating a saved audience doesn't automatically update campaigns that use it.
Init can return value.targetingEntities, an array describing the supported targeting facets. Use this response to build your targeting controls rather than hardcoding available facets.
Your targeting interface must display the targeting discrimination notice, including when it uses only Init's listed options and doesn't use typeahead searches:
LinkedIn tools may not be used to discriminate based on personal characteristics like gender, age, race, or ethnicity. Learn more.

Rows.Text: The facet URN to use as facetUrn in targeting criteria.
The optional label, description, and help URL.
The flag indicating whether the facet supports exclusion.
The selection mode. LIST uses returned options; SEARCH requires typeahead; SEARCH_AND_LIST supports either. It can be omitted.
The rules describing facets that can't be combined with this facet when it is included or excluded. Each contains cannotInclude and cannotExclude facet lists.
The available options, with urn, optional name and description, targetable, and nested children.

Blocks.Text: Keep non-targetable parent options visible so users can discover their targetable children. Don't submit a non-targetable parent as a selected value. Respect canExclude and the incompatibility rules.
Selecting a targetable parent already covers its children; select the parent or its children, not both.

For searchable facets, use the existing adTargetingEntities typeahead. Its request takes q=typeahead, an encoded facet URN, and query. Use queryVersion=QUERY_USES_URNS for targeting URNs. Follow that reference for facet-specific parameters and access requirements.

Init and Hydrate accept optional locale objects such as {"language":"en","country":"US"}. Both the language and country/region values must be nonblank; incomplete locales fall back to en_US. Locale supports suggested audience and criteria names, but doesn't guarantee localization of discovery facet labels or options.
Use geoTypeahead with q=search and the advertiser's search text in query to find location values for a custom audience. An optional locale controls the returned display names.

http


curl

GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/geoTypeahead?q=search&query=united&locale=(language:en,country:US)
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Linkedin-Version: 202611
X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/geoTypeahead?q=search&query=united&locale=(language:en,country:US)' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: 202611' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
Each result in elements includes displayText and an entity geo URN. Use the entity URN as an anyOf[].urn value under facetUrn: "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations".
Send POST /rest/boostTargetingCriteria with the owning account, a nonblank name, and includeAll containing at least one location.

http


curl

curl -i -X POST 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: 202611' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
  "account": "urn:li:sponsoredAccount:987654321",
  "name": "US English audience",
  "description": "English-speaking members in the United States",
  "includeAll": [
    {"facetUrn": "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations", "anyOf": [{"urn": "urn:li:geo:103644278"}]},
    {"facetUrn": "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:interfaceLocales", "anyOf": [{"urn": "urn:li:locale:en_US"}]}
  ]
}'
A successful request returns 201 Created, the new ID in the X-RestLi-Id response header, and no response body. Save this ID for edits and deletion.
Use GET /rest/boostTargetingCriteria?q=account&account={encodedAccountUrn}. No individual-audience GET operation is supported.

Rows.Text: The positive maximum number of audiences to return. Omit it for no limit.
The URL-encoded campaign URN. Its current audience is placed first.
The locale for returned criteria names, for example (language:en,country:US).

Blocks.Text: Results are ordered most recently used first, after any campaign audience placed first. This finder doesn't support start or offset pagination.

http


curl

GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria?q=account&account=urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A987654321&count=10&locale=(language:en,country:US)
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Linkedin-Version: 202611
X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria?q=account&account=urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A987654321&count=10&locale=(language:en,country:US)' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: 202611' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
The response contains an elements array of targeting criteria objects. For example:

Pass the selected criteria to Hydrate to preview them, then use the previewed criteria in Post. Editing a saved definition isn't the same operation as changing an existing campaign's targeting; use Manage boosts for campaign changes.
Use a Rest.li partial update: HTTP POST, X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE, and a patch body. The path key is the saved-audience ID and the account query parameter is required.

Only name, description, includeAll, and excludeAny are editable. Omitted name and description fields keep their saved values. An edit that changes only the name or description doesn't require targeting and leaves the saved targeting unchanged. Don't use $delete.

For a targeting edit, always send the complete desired includeAll list with a location facet containing at least one value. Omit excludeAny to preserve existing exclusions, send excludeAny: [] to clear them, or send a complete replacement excludeAny list to change them. An excludeAny-only edit is rejected.

http


curl

POST https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria/12345?account=urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A987654321
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Linkedin-Version: 202611
X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0
X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE
Content-Type: application/json

{"patch":{"$set":{"name":"US launch audience"}}}

curl -X POST 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria/12345?account=urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A987654321' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: 202611' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0' \
-H 'X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{"patch":{"$set":{"name":"US launch audience"}}}'

A successful edit returns 204 No Content with no body. Find account audiences again to retrieve the saved definition.

http


curl

DELETE https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria/12345
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Linkedin-Version: 202611
X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0

curl -X DELETE 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/boostTargetingCriteria/12345' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: 202611' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
A successful deletion returns 204 No Content with no body. Audience deletion doesn't use the edit operation's account query parameter.
Malformed input returns 400. Correct these conditions before retrying:

Rows.Text: Missing account, blank name, or no location value in includeAll.
Supply the owning account, a nonblank name, and a location facet with at least one value.
A targeting facet isn't supported by Boost.
Use locations and facets available through Init's targetingEntities.
Omit count or use a positive value.
Missing or invalid account, nonpositive ID, empty patch, or no editable fields.
Supply a valid key and account, and set at least one editable field.
excludeAny without includeAll, or targeting without a location.
Include the desired includeAll selections with a location.
Use the saved-audience ID returned at creation.

Blocks.Text: The audience service can also return 403 for authorization failures, 404 for missing entities, and 422 for unmet preconditions or conflicts. Follow the response message instead of retrying unchanged. Authentication and rate-limit failures can occur before the audience operation runs; service failures return 500.
